turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The days are so long now, I wake up and there is nothing I have to do.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. I keep coming back to it.
What happened next?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Take your time.
I have been having three whiskies each evening, which is more than I would like.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
Tell me more about that.
I went to Denise's grave on Sunday and talked to her for an hour.
Mm-hm. Go on.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. I think so, yes.
Tell me more about that.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little.
Take your time.
The vet said Biscuit has arthritis in his back legs and gave me tablets for him.
How did that feel for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. Yes, it was like that.
How did that feel for you?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
